verdict.rationale: SAM.gov is a government registration and filing service, so the question of whether the core flow can start without an account applies. The pack documents the opposite for programmatic access: API keys come from the logged-in account page and are tied to SAM.gov accounts, and system accounts need approval. Nothing describes a keyless or file-number entry path into entity registration; public search pages and crawlable content are not the core filing flow.
